item.title: 21-year-old Slidell man arrested, accused of indecent behavior with minor: AG Liz Murrill
item.description: Agents with the Louisiana Bureau of Investigation arrested a man accused of indecent behavior with a juvenile on Friday, Feb. 20, according to Attorney General Liz Murrill.

item.title: Court rules in favor of Jefferson Parish Council in JFI board appointment
item.description: The 24th Judicial District Court ruled in favor of the Jefferson Parish Council to appoint members to the Jefferson Facilities Incorporated board, a nonprofit overseeing the Gretna Brewpub project on Tuesday, Feb. 24.

item.title: Man accused of child sexual abuse in Terrebonne Parish
item.description: A New Orleans man is accused of sexually abusing a child in Terrebonne Parish.

item.title: Boil water advisory lifted following large water main break in Uptown leads to flooded streets
item.description: A precautionary boil water advisory has been issued for a part of Uptown New Orleans following a large water main break that left some streets shut down.

item.title: Crews respond to two-alarm fire in Central City
item.description: Firefighters responded to a two-alarm fire in Central City Tuesday, Feb. 24.

item.title: New Orleans friends witnessed explosions, burned-out cars in Puerto Vallarta
item.description: A group of friends from New Orleans are sheltering in place in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, after violence broke out after the killing of a drug cartel leader.

item.title: Water shutoffs paused for New Orleans complex due to $1.5M past-due bill
item.description: The atmosphere was tense during the Housing Authority of New Orleans meeting as issues involving the Department of Housing and Urban Development and high-water bills are still in question.

item.title: Man accused sex crimes, encouraging suicide through Roblox in Lafourche Parish
item.description: A man was arrested in connection with a teen sexual abuse investigation in Lafourche Parish on Feb. 9.

item.title: Warmer stretch of weather starting Wednesday
item.description: NEW ORLEANS (WGNO) — We’ll start to notice a little more moisture in the air tonight as winds turn in off the Gulf. Dewpoints will be creeping up, but right now there’s no strong signal that we’ll see widespread fog develop. Most of the typical indicators just aren’t lining up for a big fog event. [...]
